title: Support assistant prompt-injection flags
question: How many times did the prompt-injection guardrail flag a prompt sent to the Coralogix Store support assistant {W}? Count every guardrail check span, including replayed test prompts.

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'support-assistant' && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'guardrails' && $d.tags['gen_ai.prompt.guardrails.prompt_injection.triggered']:string == 'true' | aggregate count() as n

title: Chat assistant failed tool calls on one day
question: How many tool calls made by the GoldSpin Play chat assistant failed on {DAY4} (UTC day)?

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'chat-assistant' && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'execute_tool' && $d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR' | aggregate count() as n

title: Insight assistant output tokens on one day
question: How many output tokens did the Coralogix Finance insight assistant's LLM calls generate on {DAY5} (UTC day)?

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'insight-assistant' && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'chat' | aggregate sum($d.tags['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']:number) as t

title: Top-spending assistant user
question: Across all three customer-facing assistants, which end user generated the most LLM spend {W}, and how much in US dollars?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.applicationName == 'goldspin-play' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-store' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-finance') && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'chat' | groupby firstNonNull($d.tags['gen_ai.request.user'], $d.tags['enduser.id'], $d.tags['user.id']):string as u aggregate sum(($d.tags['gen_ai.prompt_price']:number + $d.tags['gen_ai.response_price']:number)) as c

title: Slowest insight-assistant agent
question: The Coralogix Finance insight assistant is made of several agents. Which agent has the slowest 95th-percentile invocation latency {W}, and what is that p95 in milliseconds?

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'insight-assistant' && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'invoke_agent' | groupby $d.tags['gen_ai.agent.name']:string as a aggregate percentile(0.95, $m.duration:number / 1000) as p

title: Most expensive assistant per conversation
question: Which of the three customer-facing assistants costs the most in LLM spend per conversation {W}, and what is its average LLM cost per conversation in US dollars?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.applicationName == 'goldspin-play' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-store' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-finance') && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'chat' | groupby $l.serviceName as s aggregate sum(($d.tags['gen_ai.prompt_price']:number + $d.tags['gen_ai.response_price']:number)) as c, distinct_count($d.tags['gen_ai.conversation.id']) as k

compute: (T := sorted(R[0], key=lambda r: -r['c'] / r['k']), A := {'chat-assistant': ['chat-assistant', 'chat assistant', 'goldspin'], 'support-assistant': ['support-assistant', 'support assistant', 'store'], 'insight-assistant': ['insight-assistant', 'insight assistant', 'finance']}, {'must': [A[T[0]['s']]], 'numbers': [[T[0]['c'] / T[0]['k'], 0.01]]})[-1]

title: Share of chat-assistant prompts blocked by guardrails
question: What percentage of the GoldSpin Play chat assistant's guardrail checks ended with the guardrail triggering {W}? Count every guardrail check span, including replayed test prompts.

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'chat-assistant' && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'guardrails' | aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.tags['guardrails.triggered']:string == 'True' || $d.tags['guardrails.triggered']:string == 'true', 1, 0)) as t

title: Prompt-injection rate per 1,000 LLM calls
question: Normalised for traffic, which assistant attracts the most prompt-injection attempts: give the assistant and its number of prompt-injection guardrail triggers per 1,000 LLM chat calls {W}. Count every guardrail check span, including replayed test prompts.

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.applicationName == 'goldspin-play' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-store' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-finance') && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'guardrails' && $d.tags['gen_ai.prompt.guardrails.prompt_injection.triggered']:string == 'true' | groupby $l.serviceName as s aggregate count() as n

source spans | filter ($l.applicationName == 'goldspin-play' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-store' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-finance') && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'chat' | groupby $l.serviceName as s aggregate count() as n

compute: (I := {r['s']: r['n'] for r in R[0]}, C := {r['s']: r['n'] for r in R[1]}, T := sorted([[1000 * I.get(s, 0) / C[s], s] for s in C]), A := {'chat-assistant': ['chat-assistant', 'chat assistant', 'goldspin'], 'support-assistant': ['support-assistant', 'support assistant', 'store'], 'insight-assistant': ['insight-assistant', 'insight assistant', 'finance']}, {'must': [A[T[-1][1]]], 'numbers': [[T[-1][0], 0.01]]})[-1]

title: Insight assistant's biggest-spending user, profiled
question: FinOps wants a profile of the Coralogix Finance insight assistant's biggest-spending user {W}. Who is it, what was their total LLM spend in US dollars, how many conversations did they have, and what was their average LLM cost per conversation?

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'insight-assistant' && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'chat' | groupby firstNonNull($d.tags['gen_ai.request.user'], $d.tags['enduser.id'], $d.tags['user.id']):string as u aggregate sum(($d.tags['gen_ai.prompt_price']:number + $d.tags['gen_ai.response_price']:number)) as c, distinct_count($d.tags['gen_ai.conversation.id']) as k

title: Odds tool failures vs price-feed staleness
question: The GoldSpin Play chat assistant's get_market_odds tool sometimes fails. Find the UTC day {W} with the most get_market_odds failures, say how many failed that day, and how many stale-price errors (StaleMarketPriceError or PriceFeedStale) the odds-feed service logged on that same day.

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'chat-assistant' && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'execute_tool' && $d.tags['gen_ai.tool.name'] == 'get_market_odds' && $d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate count() as n

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'goldspin-play' && $l.subsystemname == 'odds-feed' && ($d.attributes['error.type'] == 'StaleMarketPriceError' || $d.attributes['error.type'] == 'PriceFeedStale') | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate count() as n

title: Baskets started
question: How many shopping baskets were started on Coralogix Store {W}?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'basket.started' | aggregate count() as n

title: Declined order value
question: What was the total value in GBP of Coralogix Store orders that were declined at payment {W}?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.declined' | aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Max stock replica lag
question: What was the worst replication lag seen on the store's lagging stock-ledger replica {W}? Give it in seconds.

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['stock.ledger.name'] == 'stock-ledger-replica-3' | aggregate max($d.logRecord.attributes['stock.replica_lag_ms']:number) as mx

title: Pool-exhaustion checkout failures, one day
question: On {DAY2} (UTC), how many checkout attempts at Coralogix Store failed because the checkout service had no database connection available? Count each failed checkout once.

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'CheckoutFailed' | groupby $l.subsystemname as s aggregate count() as n

compute: {'must': [], 'numbers': [[[r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'checkout-service'][0]['n'], 0.005]]}

title: Click-and-collect orders, one day
question: How many Coralogix Store orders were placed for click-and-collect on {DAY5} (UTC day)?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.placed' && $d.logRecord.attributes['delivery.method'] == 'click-collect' | groupby $l.subsystemname as s aggregate count() as n

compute: {'must': [], 'numbers': [], 'numbers_any': [[sum([r['n'] for r in R[0]]), 0.005], [[r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'order-service'][0]['n'], 0.005]]}

title: Department hit hardest by genuine stock-outs
question: Which product department lost the most order value to items that were genuinely out of stock (not stock-ledger sync problems) {W}, and how much in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.lost' && $d.logRecord.attributes['stock.cause'] == 'genuinely-out-of-stock' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['product.department']:string as dep aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Most-used promo code
question: Which promo code was used on the most placed Coralogix Store orders {W}, and on how many orders?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.placed' && $d.logRecord.attributes['order.promo_code'] != 'none' && $d.logRecord.attributes['order.promo_code'] != null | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['order.promo_code']:string as p, $l.subsystemname as s aggregate count() as n

compute: {'must': [[top([{'p': p, 'n': sum([r['n'] for r in R[0] if r['p'] == p])} for p in ['ACADEMY20','MERCH15','WELCOME10','FREESHIP']],'n')[0]['p']]], 'numbers': [], 'numbers_any': [[top([{'p': p, 'n': sum([r['n'] for r in R[0] if r['p'] == p])} for p in ['ACADEMY20','MERCH15','WELCOME10','FREESHIP']],'n')[0]['n'], 0.005], [top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'order-service'],'n')[0]['n'], 0.005]]}
unique: top([{'p': p, 'n': sum([r['n'] for r in R[0] if r['p'] == p])} for p in ['ACADEMY20','MERCH15','WELCOME10','FREESHIP']],'n')[0]['n'] > 1.01 * top([{'p': p, 'n': sum([r['n'] for r in R[0] if r['p'] == p])} for p in ['ACADEMY20','MERCH15','WELCOME10','FREESHIP']],'n')[1]['n'] and top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'order-service'],'n')[0]['p'] == top([{'p': p, 'n': sum([r['n'] for r in R[0] if r['p'] == p])} for p in ['ACADEMY20','MERCH15','WELCOME10','FREESHIP']],'n')[0]['p']

title: Payment method with most declined value
question: Which payment method accounted for the most declined order value at Coralogix Store {W}, and how much in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.declined' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['payment.method']:string as m aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Delivery method with highest revenue
question: Which delivery method brought in the most placed-order revenue at Coralogix Store {W}, and how much in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.placed' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['delivery.method']:string as m, $l.subsystemname as s aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

compute: {'must': [[top([{'m': m, 'v': sum([r['v'] for r in R[0] if r['m'] == m])} for m in ['standard','named-day','click-collect']],'v')[0]['m']]], 'numbers': [], 'numbers_any': [[gbp(top([{'m': m, 'v': sum([r['v'] for r in R[0] if r['m'] == m])} for m in ['standard','named-day','click-collect']],'v')[0]['v']), 0.005], [gbp(top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'order-service'],'v')[0]['v']), 0.005]]}
unique: top([{'m': m, 'v': sum([r['v'] for r in R[0] if r['m'] == m])} for m in ['standard','named-day','click-collect']],'v')[0]['v'] > 1.01 * top([{'m': m, 'v': sum([r['v'] for r in R[0] if r['m'] == m])} for m in ['standard','named-day','click-collect']],'v')[1]['v']

title: Leakiest funnel stage
question: At which step do Coralogix Store shoppers abandon the most baskets {W}, and what percentage of all abandoned baskets does that step account for?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'basket.abandoned' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['abandon.stage']:string as st aggregate count() as n

title: Deepest effective discount
question: Which promo code gave the deepest effective discount at Coralogix Store {W}, measured as total discount divided by total pre-discount value of the orders that used it? Give the percentage.

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.placed' && $d.logRecord.attributes['order.promo_code'] != 'none' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['order.promo_code']:string as p aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v, sum($d.logRecord.attributes['order.discount_minor']:number) as d

compute: {'must': [[sorted(R[0], key=lambda r: -r['d']/(r['v']+r['d']))[0]['p']]], 'numbers': [[pct(sorted(R[0], key=lambda r: -r['d']/(r['v']+r['d']))[0]['d'], sorted(R[0], key=lambda r: -r['d']/(r['v']+r['d']))[0]['v'] + sorted(R[0], key=lambda r: -r['d']/(r['v']+r['d']))[0]['d']), 0.01]]}

title: Overall gross margin on orders
question: What was Coralogix Store's gross margin percentage on placed orders {W}, computed as (order revenue - cost of goods) / order revenue?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && ($d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.placed' || $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.cogs') | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']:string as ev aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

compute: {'must': [], 'numbers': [[pct([r for r in R[0] if r['ev'] == 'order.placed'][0]['v'] - [r for r in R[0] if r['ev'] == 'order.cogs'][0]['v'], [r for r in R[0] if r['ev'] == 'order.placed'][0]['v']), 0.01]]}

title: Phantom share of stock-out losses
question: Of all order value Coralogix Store lost to out-of-stock refusals {W}, what percentage was caused by the stock ledger being out of sync rather than genuine shortages, and which department did those phantom stock-outs hit?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.lost' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['stock.cause']:string as c, $d.logRecord.attributes['product.department']:string as dep aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

compute: {'must': [[top([r for r in R[0] if r['c'] == 'ledger-out-of-sync'],'v')[0]['dep']]], 'numbers': [[pct(sum([r['v'] for r in R[0] if r['c'] == 'ledger-out-of-sync']), sum([r['v'] for r in R[0]])), 0.01]]}

title: Distinct ordering customers
question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order at Coralogix Store {W}?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.placed' | aggregate distinct_count($d.logRecord.attributes['user.id']) as u

title: Lines per order
question: On average, how many distinct product lines did a placed Coralogix Store order contain {W}?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && ($d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.placed' || $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.line') | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']:string as ev aggregate count() as n, avg($d.logRecord.attributes['order.lines']:number) as al

compute: {'must': [], 'numbers': [], 'numbers_any': [[[r for r in R[0] if r['ev'] == 'order.placed'][0]['al'], 0.01], [[r for r in R[0] if r['ev'] == 'order.line'][0]['n'] / [r for r in R[0] if r['ev'] == 'order.placed'][0]['n'], 0.01]]}

title: Worst day of stock-ledger refusals
question: Checkout at Coralogix Store refuses to reserve stock when a stock-ledger replica falls behind. Find the UTC day {W} on which the checkout service logged the most such refusals. Report: the day, how many refusals checkout logged that day, which replica was behind, and the order value in GBP lost that day to ledger-out-of-sync stock-outs.

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.subsystemname == 'checkout-service' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'StockLedgerUnavailable' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate count() as n

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.lost' && $d.logRecord.attributes['stock.cause'] == 'ledger-out-of-sync' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Connection-pool checkout failures: worst hour
question: Coralogix Store checkouts sometimes fail outright with a checkout error. Counting each failed checkout once, which UTC hour {W} had the most of these failures, how many were there, and what resource ran out to cause them?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.subsystemname == 'checkout-service' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'CheckoutFailed' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h), '%Y-%m-%dT%H') as h aggregate count() as n

title: Recommendations outage root cause
question: Product recommendations at Coralogix Store fail when the recommendation model is unavailable. Which service is the root cause, which UTC day {W} had the most of these failures, and how many distinct failures were there that day?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'ModelUnavailable' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d, $l.subsystemname as s aggregate count() as n

compute: {'must': [['recommendation-service', 'recommendation service'], [top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'], top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][8:10].lstrip('0')+' '+MON3[top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][5:7]], MON3[top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][5:7]]+' '+top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][8:10].lstrip('0'), MONF[top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][5:7]]+' '+top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][8:10].lstrip('0'), top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][5:7]+'/'+top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][8:10], top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][8:10]+'/'+top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['d'][5:7]]], 'numbers': [[top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['n'], 0.005]]}
unique: top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[0]['n'] > 1.01 * top([r for r in R[0] if r['s'] == 'recommendation-service'],'n')[1]['n']

title: Slowest checkout dependency
question: Looking at traces, which downstream call made by the Coralogix Store checkout service has the highest p95 latency {W}? Give the operation, its p95 in milliseconds, and how many of those calls errored.

ref.query: source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'checkout-service' && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'client' | groupby $l.operationName as op aggregate percentile(0.95, $m.duration:number / 1000) as p95, count() as n, sum(if($d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR', 1, 0)) as err

title: Worst day for payment declines
question: On the UTC day {W} with the most declined Coralogix Store orders, how many orders were declined, what was their total value in GBP, and what decline code and reason did the issuer give?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.declined' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate count() as n, sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.declined' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['decline.code']:string as c, $d.logRecord.attributes['decline.reason']:string as r aggregate count() as n

title: Billed research queries
question: How many research queries did Coralogix Finance bill to clients {W}?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed' | aggregate count() as n

title: Query revenue billed
question: What was Coralogix Finance's total research query revenue billed to clients {W}, in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed' | aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Uncited-answer refunds
question: Coralogix Finance refunds credits when a research answer comes back without citations. How many such refunds were issued {W}, and what was their total value in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'credit.refunded' | aggregate count() as n, sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Market-data vendor cost
question: How much did Coralogix Finance spend on market-data vendor calls for research queries {W}, in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'vendor.datacall.charged' | aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Top segment by query revenue
question: Which client segment generated the most research query revenue for Coralogix Finance {W}, and how much in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['user.segment']:string as seg aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v | orderby v desc

title: Top region by billed queries
question: Which research region had the most billed research queries at Coralogix Finance {W}, and how many?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['research.region']:string as r aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc

title: Top client by query revenue
question: Which individual client user generated the most billed research query revenue at Coralogix Finance {W}, and how much in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['user.id']:string as u aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v | orderby v desc | limit 5

title: Asset class with most guardrail refusals
question: Which research asset class had the most queries refused by guardrails at Coralogix Finance {W}, and how many refusals?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.failed' && $d.logRecord.attributes['outcome'] == 'refused' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['research.asset_class']:string as ac aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc

title: Worst day for vendor quota errors
question: On which UTC day {W} did Coralogix Finance log the most vendor-quota-exceeded errors (count every error log, across all services), and how many?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'VendorQuotaExceeded' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc

title: Highest refund rate by region
question: Measured by value (credits refunded divided by query revenue billed), which research region had the highest refund rate at Coralogix Finance {W}, and what was that rate as a percentage?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && ($d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'credit.refunded' || $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed') | create ev from $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']:string | create amt from $d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['research.region']:string as r aggregate sum(if(ev == 'credit.refunded', amt, 0)) as ref, sum(if(ev == 'query.billed', amt, 0)) as bil | create rate from 100.0 * ref / bil | orderby rate desc

title: Overall gross margin
question: What was Coralogix Finance's gross margin on research queries {W}, defined as (query revenue billed - credits refunded - inference costs - market-data costs) / query revenue billed? Give it as a percentage.

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.domain'] == 'business' | create ev from $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']:string | create amt from $d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number | aggregate sum(if(ev == 'query.billed', amt, 0)) as bil, sum(if(ev == 'credit.refunded', amt, 0)) as ref, sum(if(ev == 'inference.charged', amt, 0)) as inf, sum(if(ev == 'vendor.datacall.charged', amt, 0)) as md

title: Lowest average price per query by segment
question: Which client segment paid the lowest average price per billed research query at Coralogix Finance {W}, and what was that average in pence?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['user.segment']:string as seg aggregate avg($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as a | orderby a asc

title: Boutique cost-to-serve ratio
question: For boutique clients only, what were Coralogix Finance's combined inference and market-data costs as a percentage of the research query revenue billed to those clients {W}?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['user.segment'] == 'boutique' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.domain'] == 'business' | create ev from $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']:string | create amt from $d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number | aggregate sum(if(ev == 'query.billed', amt, 0)) as bil, sum(if(ev == 'inference.charged' || ev == 'vendor.datacall.charged', amt, 0)) as cost

title: Vendor quota impact on top-affected client
question: Vendor management wants to know who is hurt most by market-data quota exhaustion at Coralogix Finance {W}. Which client user had the most vendor-quota rejections logged by the market-data gateway, how many rejections, what share (%) of that client's live-prices API requests returned HTTP 503, and how much query revenue (GBP) did that client generate in the same window?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $l.subsystemname == 'market-data-gateway' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'VendorQuotaExceeded' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['user.id']:string as u aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc | limit 5

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $l.subsystemname == 'research-gateway' && $d.logRecord.attributes['http.route'] == '/api/live-prices' && $d.logRecord.attributes['http.status_code'] != null | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['user.id']:string as u aggregate count() as total, sum(if($d.logRecord.attributes['http.status_code']:string == '503', 1, 0)) as bad

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'query.billed' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['user.id']:string as u aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Regional refund concentration root cause
question: Refunds for uncited answers at Coralogix Finance are concentrated in one research region {W}. Which region is it, how much was refunded there in GBP, which corpus vendor serves that region's retrieval, and what was the average corpus freshness for that region in hours?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'credit.refunded' | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['research.region']:string as r aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v | orderby v desc

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $l.subsystemname == 'research-gateway' && $d.logRecord.attributes['corpus.region'] != null | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['corpus.region']:string as r, $d.logRecord.attributes['corpus.vendor']:string as vendor aggregate avg($d.logRecord.attributes['corpus.freshness_seconds']:number) as fresh, count() as n

title: Most profitable asset class
question: Finance wants unit economics by research asset class at Coralogix Finance {W}. Which asset class contributed the most gross profit in GBP, defined as query revenue billed minus credits refunded minus inference costs minus market-data costs? Give the asset class, the gross profit in GBP, and its gross margin as a percentage of its billed revenue.

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.domain'] == 'business' && $d.logRecord.attributes['research.asset_class'] != null | create ev from $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name']:string | create amt from $d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number | groupby $d.logRecord.attributes['research.asset_class']:string as ac aggregate sum(if(ev == 'query.billed', amt, 0)) as bil, sum(if(ev == 'credit.refunded', amt, 0)) as ref, sum(if(ev == 'inference.charged', amt, 0)) as inf, sum(if(ev == 'vendor.datacall.charged', amt, 0)) as md | create gp from bil - ref - inf - md | orderby gp desc

title: Worst day for ledger conflicts
question: Coralogix Finance's billing service occasionally fails to consume credits because of ledger conflicts. On which UTC day {W} did the billing service log the most credit-ledger conflicts, how many were there that day, and how many distinct client users were affected that day?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $l.subsystemname == 'billing-service' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'CreditLedgerConflict' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.logRecord.attributes['user.id']) as users | orderby n desc

title: Retrieval index outage hour
question: The Coralogix Finance retrieval path depends on a vector index that sometimes has shards unavailable. In which single UTC hour {W} were the most index-shard-unavailable errors logged (count every ERROR log with that error type, across services), how many were logged in that hour, and how many vendor-quota-exceeded errors were logged across Coralogix Finance in that same hour?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $m.severity == ERROR && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'IndexShardUnavailable' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h), '%Y-%m-%dT%H') as h aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc | limit 5

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance' && $d.logRecord.attributes['error.type'] == 'VendorQuotaExceeded' | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h), '%Y-%m-%dT%H') as h aggregate count() as n

title: Jackpot game paying most
question: Which jackpot game paid out the most jackpot value at GoldSpin Play {W}, and how much did it pay in GBP?

title: Market with most accepted stake
question: Which betting market took the most accepted stake at GoldSpin Play {W}, and how much stake in GBP?

title: Segment with most held withdrawals

title: Suspended market root cause

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'goldspin-play' && $d.attributes['event.name'] == 'bet.rejected' && $d.attributes['reject.reason'] == 'market-unavailable' | groupby $d.attributes['bet.market']:string as m aggregate sum($d.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

question: One card issuer refuses deposits to GoldSpin Play because it blocks gambling transactions. {W}, which issuer is it, how many distinct customers did it affect, what deposit value (GBP) did it decline for that reason, and what share (%) of all issuer-declined deposit value does that represent?

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'goldspin-play' && $d.attributes['event.name'] == 'deposit.declined' | aggregate sum($d.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

title: Slowest dependency inside PlaceBet

source spans | filter $l.serviceName == 'bet-service' && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'client' | groupby $l.operationName as op aggregate percentile(0.95, $m.duration:number / 1000) as p

title: Business with the most error logs
question: Of GoldSpin Play, Coralogix Store and Coralogix Finance, which business logged the most ERROR-severity logs {W}, and how many?

ref.query: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'goldspin-play' || $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' || $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance') && $m.severity == ERROR | groupby $l.applicationname as app aggregate count() as n

title: Failed requests at the three API gateways
question: How many requests failed in total at the three businesses' public API gateways (GoldSpin edge-gateway, Store store-gateway, Finance research-gateway) {W}, judged by server spans with error status?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.serviceName == 'edge-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'store-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'research-gateway') && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'server' && $d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR' | aggregate count() as n

title: Gateway route with the worst error rate
question: Looking at all three public API gateways {W}, which route with at least 10,000 requests has the highest failure rate (share of requests that failed, whatever the status code), and what is that failure rate as a percentage?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.serviceName == 'edge-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'store-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'research-gateway') && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'server' | groupby $l.applicationName as app, $l.operationName as op aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR', 1, 0)) as e

title: Business with the highest error-log share
question: Which of the three businesses has the highest proportion of its logs at ERROR severity {W}, and what is that proportion as a percentage?

ref.query: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'goldspin-play' || $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' || $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-finance') | groupby $l.applicationname as app aggregate count() as n, sum(if($m.severity == ERROR, 1, 0)) as e

compute: (T := sorted([[r['e'] / r['n'], r['app']] for r in R[0]]), B := {'goldspin-play': ['goldspin'], 'coralogix-store': ['store'], 'coralogix-finance': ['finance', 'research']}, {'must': [B[T[-1][1]]], 'numbers': [[100 * T[-1][0], 0.01]]})[-1]

title: Slowest gateway route
question: Across the three public API gateways {W}, which route has the slowest 95th-percentile server latency, and what is that p95 in milliseconds?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.serviceName == 'edge-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'store-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'research-gateway') && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'server' | groupby $l.applicationName as app, $l.operationName as op aggregate percentile(0.95, $m.duration:number / 1000) as p

title: Revenue lost to infrastructure faults, gaming vs store
question: Two infrastructure faults cost money {W}: GoldSpin Play refused bets because markets had no live price, and Coralogix Store told customers items were out of stock because its stock ledger was out of sync. Which business lost more (refused stake vs lost order value), and by how much in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'goldspin-play' && $d.attributes['event.name'] == 'bet.rejected' && $d.attributes['reject.reason'] == 'market-unavailable' | aggregate sum($d.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.lost' && $d.logRecord.attributes['stock.cause'] == 'ledger-out-of-sync' | aggregate sum($d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']:number) as v

compute: (G := R[0][0]['v'], ST := R[1][0]['v'], {'must': [['store'] if ST > G else ['goldspin']], 'numbers': [[gbp(abs(ST - G)), 0.005]]})[-1]

title: Gateway error rate by business
question: Which business's public API gateway failed the largest share of its requests {W} (server spans with error status divided by all server spans), and what was that share as a percentage?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.serviceName == 'edge-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'store-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'research-gateway') && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'server' | groupby $l.applicationName as app aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR', 1, 0)) as e

compute: (T := sorted([[r['e'] / r['n'], r['app']] for r in R[0]]), B := {'goldspin-play': ['goldspin'], 'coralogix-store': ['store'], 'coralogix-finance': ['finance', 'research']}, {'must': [B[T[-1][1]]], 'numbers': [[100 * T[-1][0], 0.01]]})[-1]

title: Store order failures vs GoldSpin bet failures in the same hour
question: Find the UTC hour {W} with the most failed order submissions at the Coralogix Store gateway (POST /api/orders server spans with error status). How many failed in that hour, and how many POST /api/bets requests failed at the GoldSpin edge gateway in that same hour?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.serviceName == 'edge-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'store-gateway' || $l.serviceName == 'research-gateway') && $d.tags['span.kind'] == 'server' && $d.tags['otel.status_code'] == 'ERROR' && ($l.operationName == 'POST /api/orders' || $l.operationName == 'POST /api/bets') | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h), '%Y-%m-%dT%H') as hr, $l.operationName as op aggregate count() as n

unique: (P := sorted([[r['n'], r['hr']] for r in R[0] if r['op'] == 'POST /api/orders']), P[-1][0] > P[-2][0])[-1]

title: Assistant cost efficiency league table
question: Compare the three businesses' customer-facing assistants on cost efficiency {W}: LLM spend in US dollars per 1,000 successful LLM chat calls. Which assistant is cheapest and which is most expensive on that measure, and what are their two figures?

ref.query: source spans | filter ($l.applicationName == 'goldspin-play' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-store' || $l.applicationName == 'coralogix-finance') && $d.tags['gen_ai.operation.name'] == 'chat' && $d.tags['otel.status_code'] != 'ERROR' | groupby $l.serviceName as s aggregate sum(($d.tags['gen_ai.prompt_price']:number + $d.tags['gen_ai.response_price']:number)) as c, count() as n

compute: (T := sorted([[1000 * r['c'] / r['n'], r['s']] for r in R[0]]), A := {'chat-assistant': ['chat-assistant', 'chat assistant', 'goldspin'], 'support-assistant': ['support-assistant', 'support assistant', 'store'], 'insight-assistant': ['insight-assistant', 'insight assistant', 'finance']}, {'must': [A[T[0][1]], A[T[-1][1]]], 'numbers': [[T[0][0], 0.01], [T[-1][0], 0.01]]})[-1]

title: Worst day for combined infrastructure-fault losses
question: Combine two infrastructure-fault losses per UTC day {W}: stake GoldSpin Play refused because a market had no live price, plus order value Coralogix Store lost to false out-of-stock errors caused by its stock ledger being out of sync. Which day had the highest combined loss, and how much was it in GBP?

ref.query: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'goldspin-play' && $d.attributes['event.name'] == 'bet.rejected' && $d.attributes['reject.reason'] == 'market-unavailable') || ($l.applicationname == 'coralogix-store' && $d.logRecord.attributes['event.name'] == 'order.lost' && $d.logRecord.attributes['stock.cause'] == 'ledger-out-of-sync') | groupby formatTimestamp(roundTime($m.timestamp, 1d), '%Y-%m-%d') as d aggregate sum(firstNonNull($d.attributes['money.amount_minor'], $d.logRecord.attributes['money.amount_minor']):number) as v
